body:
Greg's direction (2026-11-03 06:35Z, relayed verbatim by Engram::Asistant in TermAl mailbox 588693a8 #121): „Ok. To bedzie następna rzecz po poprawkach.”

Meaning: splitting the TermAl backend into smaller Rust crates, with evaluation (acceptance_*) and test-run registration (test_run*) first, is the NEXT work stream once the fixes currently queued have landed.
- Plan: spike w-ae109290885c (Termal::Architect2) prepares a phased plan now.
- Implementation starts after the current fix queue lands (see central-queue-2026-11-03).
- The team proceeds autonomously, with no further approval round trip needed for the plan.
- Likely first phase: convert the 384 include! fragments into real modules, as pure moves.
